statement: All-sheet analytic patching replaces a branched curve cover by a finite etale upper cover once roots exist on the entire inverse boundary collars; evaluation at the specified H-valued point yields the required K0-embedding; horizontal index bounds survive subextensions, composita, Galois closures, normalized pullback, and etale upper composition.

notes: A reconstruction of the supplied R24 argument, with no priority claim. The analytic root normal form is proved even when p divides the horizontal index. Properness controls the entire inverse disk. All degree-d sheets are trivialized, including factors whose root-of-unity differences have small norm. Proper GAGA algebraizes the finite locally free algebra with its unit and multiplication. The whole H-point, not only its underlying Berkovich point, is transported through the analytic map. Horizontal characteristic zero is kept separate from residue-characteristic-p reduction. No assertion is made about arbitrary composition of two ramified covers. This fragment does not certify R24's later stages or final section-conjecture conclusion.

statement: Every finite set of stable-node annular coordinates acquires prime-to-p ell-th roots on the entire inverse annuli in one connected finite etale cover; resolution of nonsingularities moves arbitrary small branch collars into such stable node annuli; consequently the specified field L_ell is contained in H inside E.

notes: A reconstruction of the supplied R24 argument, with no priority claim. The full open-annulus unit factorization is proved. The separating-edge cover is connected on both sides and makes every lifted bridge nonseparating. Inverse-skeleton equality is used to control whole node annuli, including off-skeleton balls. The RNS use requires only a stable-model morphism to the prescribed model, not a finite model morphism. An irrational valuation level and the compact complement supply an entire inverse collar. Proper finite-etale base-change invariance descends the final cover, while its exterior analytic map need not descend. Normality identifies the abstract embedding of F with the previously specified subfield F in E. The claimed conclusion is L_ell subset H; the passage to all of Ksep is a separate subsequent stage.
